# Third-party license evidence

Store the unmodified upstream license text and any required copyright/attribution notices in a subfolder named after the component.

Do not add a license file based only on a repository description or a search result. Verify the exact pinned release or commit and its full dependency/binary distribution. Record source modifications and any corresponding-source or installation-information obligations in the root THIRD_PARTY.md.

This folder intentionally starts without copied license texts: no third-party component has been approved for bundling yet.
